text: Provides a hosted MCP server so each agent gets its own monday.com identity
quote: Use our native integration, or manually connect with our hosted MCP url. Each agent gets its own identity on monday.

text: Lets external AI providers (Claude, ChatGPT, Make, etc.) connect as agents via managed connection, webhook, or a code-first apps framework
quote: Connect agents from Claude, ChatGPT, Make, or any provider through a managed connection or a simple webhook — or build code-first with the apps framework.

text: Supports building custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets, and full-page apps
quote: Create custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets, and full-page apps.

text: Offers Vibe, an open-source React component library for building native-feeling apps
quote: Build with Vibe, monday's open-source React components, and look native instantly.

text: Deploys agent syncs and tools to monday-managed isolated sandboxes rather than customer infrastructure
quote: Deploy to isolated sandboxes monday manages. Your syncs and tools run on our infra, not yours.

text: Allows requesting granular API scopes (e.g. boards:read) and storing keys in managed secret storage
quote: Request granular scopes like `boards:read`. Store keys in managed secret storage.

text: Supports webhook subscriptions to events like item creation and column value changes
Provides a unified Models API to wire apps and agents to Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI
quote: Wire your apps and agents to leading providers — Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI — through one unified Models API.

text: Lets developers run and manage every monday agent programmatically from their own code
quote: Run and manage every monday agent programmatically from your own code, anywhere you need it.

text: Admin dashboard to scope each agent's board access, audit every action, and track AI credit spend org-wide
quote: Scope each agent's board access from the admin, audit every action it takes, and track AI credit spend across the whole org — all from one dashboard.

text: Users can converse with agents like teammates — message them, assign items, and @mention to trigger work
quote: Talk to agents like teammates. Message them in updates, assign them items, and @mention them in any conversation to kick off real work — replies, statuses, and follow-ups included.

text: One agent identity is reachable across Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, Make, MCP, and API without rebuilding per channel
quote: Bring an agent in once and reach it from Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, Make, our MCP, or the API. One identity, every surface — no rebuilding per channel.

text: Lets users build custom agents by defining a goal and setting rules for their exact needs
quote: Build agents for your exact needs. Define the goal, set the rules, watch the results.

text: Lets users describe a workflow in plain language to auto-create a unique agent in minutes
quote: Describe any workflow in your own words to create a unique agent in minutes.
